title: Simple generic class
description: Create a generic class called Contenedor that can store a single value of any type, with guardar() and obtener() methods.
hints: Declare a private attribute T contenido
In main create Contenedor<String> and Contenedor<Integer>
solutionExplanation: The Contenedor<T> class has an attribute of type T. The guardar() and obtener() methods work with that generic type. In main we create instances for String and Integer, demonstrating that the same class works with any type.

title: Generic method to find the maximum
description: Write a generic method that finds the maximum value in an array of comparable elements. Use a bounded type parameter.
hints: The signature is <T extends Comparable<T>> T maximo(T[] arr)
Initialize a variable max with arr[0]
solutionExplanation: The bounded type parameter <T extends Comparable<T>> guarantees that only comparable types can use the method. compareTo() returns a positive value if the current element is greater. The same method works with Integer and String.

title: Wildcards with ? extends and ? super
description: Implement the copiar method that uses PECS: copies elements from a source list (? extends T) to a destination list (? super T).
hints: Signature: <T> void copiar(List<? extends T> src, List<? super T> dest)
Add each element to dest with dest.add()
List<Number> can receive Integer because Integer extends Number
solutionExplanation: The PECS principle: src produces elements (? extends T), dest consumes elements (? super T). ? extends T allows reading Integer as Number. ? super T allows adding Integer to List<Number>. This is exactly how Collections.copy() works.
